PRESENT : SRI J.N.SUBRAMANYA, B.A., L.L.M.,
 Chief Judge, Prl. M.A.C.T.,
 Court of Small Causes, Bengaluru.

Petitioner: Sri. Lakshman G.,
 S/o Late Guruswamy,
 Hindu, Aged 43 years,
 R/at No.77/A, 12th Cross,
 Mahalakshmi Layout,
 Bengaluru-560 086.

(By Sri.T.C.Sathishkumar, Advocate)
 -Vs- Respondents: 1.

Sri.Purushotham Gowda,
 Father name not known,
 Hindu, Major,
 R/at No.41/2, Opp. Railway  Gate, Chinappanahalli,
 Marathahalli,
 Bengaluru -560037.
(Absent)

2. Sri.Rahul M,
 S/o Madaiah,
 Hindu, Major,
 R/at No.10/29, 6th Cross,
 SCCH-1 2 MVC No.3436/2023  II Main Road, Near Ravi School Road,
 Kurubarahalli, Bangalore-560 086.
(Absent)

* * 
 JUDGMENT Petitioner being the owner of Toyota Etios car bearing No.KA-03-AB-7514 filed petition under Section 166 of IMV Act claiming damages worth of Rs.4,68,000/- from the respondents, who are the Lakshman.G vs Purushotham Gowda on 6 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72581083/
1 owner and driver of another car bearing Reg.No.KA-05-MJ-5250 alleging that on 08.05.2022 at about 11.15 p.m., on Bengaluru-Bellary road, near Byatarayanapura Junction, when driving the car bearing No.KA-03-AB-7514, driver of another car bearing No.KA-05-MJ-5250 drove the same negligently, dashed the same to hind part of car bearing No.KA-03-AB- 7514, thereby caused the accident, caused damage to car bearing No.KA-03-AB-7514 .
2.
Regarding accident Hebbal Traffic police registered a crime No.41/2022.
3. Petitioner get repaired the Tata Etios car bearing No.KA-03-AB-7514 at Thrive Automobiles by spending Rs.3,00,000/-.
4. Insurer of the Toyota Etios car under own damage claim clause paid Rs.1,32,000/- towards damages.
Therefore, the respondents are liable to pay surplus Rs.3,00,000/- towards damages.
5. Inspite of service of notice, the respondent No.1 and 2 remained absent.
6. On 02.09.2024 petitioner deposed as P.W.1 and produced 16 documents at Ex.P.1 to P.16.
On 18.12.2024 petitioner produced evidence of Anand Hadapad, car repairer/worker in a garage as P.W.2 and get produced copy of his Aadhar card at Ex.P.17.
7. I heard the arguments submitted on behalf of petitioner and perused the records.

8. On the basis of the materials available in the file, the following points arise for my consideration:
1.

Whether the petitioner proves that on 08.05.2022 at about 11.15 p.m. on Bangalore- Bellary road, near Byatarayanapura Junction, within the limits of Hebbal traffic police station, in view of negligence use of car bearing No.KA- 05-MJ-5250, the same car dashed to the Toyota Etios bearing No.KA-03-AB-7514, thereby accident taken place, resulting in damage to the Totota Etios car bearing No.KA-03-AB-7514?
2. Whether the petitioner is entitled to receive damages?
If so, how much and from whom?
3. What order?

9. On the basis of materials on record, my findings on the above points are as under:
Point No.1 ...
In the affirmative; Point No.2 ...

Petitioner is entitle to Rs.50,000/-
with current and future interest at 6% p.a. from respondents as damages.
Point No.3 ...

As per final order for the following:-
REASONS Lakshman.G vs Purushotham Gowda on 6 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72581083/
2 10. Point No.1 :- In the evidence PW1/petitioner stated that on 08.05.2022 at 11.15 p.m. when driving the Toyota Etios car bearing No.KA-03-AB-7514 from Bengaluru International Air Port towards Vidyaranyapura, near Byatarayanapura junction, on Bengaluru-Bellary road, driver of car bearing No.KA-05-MJ-5250 drove the same negligently from back side, dashed the same to Toyota Etios car bearing No.KA-03-AB-7514, thereby caused the accident, caused damage to car bearing No.KA- 03-AB-7514.
11.
In this case respondent No.1 and 2-owner and driver of car bearing No.KA-05-MJ-5250 remained absent.

12. Ex.P.1 is the copy of the FIR and complaint pertaining to crime No.41/2022 registered by Hebbal Traffic police against driver of Car bearing Reg.No. KA-05- MJ-5250 for having committed offence punishable under Section 279, 337 of IPC and Section 185 of IMV Act on the basis of the complaint presented by Surath Sahil Rao, S/o.Surat Govinda Rao.
Ex . P.2
is the copy of Sketch of place of accident.
Ex.P.3 is the copy of spot mahazar.
Ex.P.4 is the copy of vehicles seizure mahazar.
Ex.P5 is the copy of Motor Vehicle Accident report dated 12.05.2022 in which damage noticed by the Motor Vehicles Inspector in the cars bearing No.KA-03-AB-7514 and KA-05-MJ-5250 are mentioned.
Ex.P.6 is the copy of P.F. Report No.15/2022.

Ex.P.7 is the copy of the charge sheet filed by Hebbal traffic police in crime No.41/2022 against respondent No.2 - Rahul M., S/o.Madaiah, driver of Car bearing Reg.No.KA-05-MJ-5250 for having committed offence punishable under Sections 279, 337,
338 of IPC and under Sec.185 of IMV Act.

Ex.P.8 is the copy of accusation recorded in C.C.No.5314/2022 by the MMTC-5 of respondent No.2 Rahul M., which shows that on 27.12.2022 in C.C.No.5314/2022 the respondent No.2 pleaded guilty for having committed offence punishable under Section 146 r/w Section 196 of M.V.Act and under Sections 279, 337 and 338 of IPC.
13.
In this case there are no reasons to disbelieve the contents of the police records and evidence placed by the petitioner regarding reason, mode and consequence of the accident.

Copy of the Judgment dated 29.01.2024 passed in MVC No.5058/2022 by this authority shows that in that case this authority recorded a finding that due to negligent use of car bearing No.KA-50-MJ-5250 on 8.5.2022 at 11.15 p.m., accident taken place between car bearing No.KA-01- AC-6880 and car bearing No.KA-50-MJ-5250 resulting in the injuries to Surath Sahi Rao, inmate of car bearing No.KA-01-6880.

Hence, I came to the conclusion that on 8.5.2022 at 11.15 p.m. on Bengaluru-Bellary road, near Byatarayanapura Junction, when petitioner driving the car bearing No.KA-03-AB-7514 towards Vidyaranayapura, respondent No.2-Rahul M. negligently drove the car bearing No.KA-05-MJ-5250 dashed the same to Tata Etios car bearing No.KA-03-AB-7514, thereby caused accident, caused damage to car bearing No.KA-03-AB-7514.
Hence, I answer Point No.1 in the Affirmative.
14. Point No.2:

In the evidence petitioner stated that in the accident entire body, right rear wheels disc, dickie and door, rear bumper, both tile lamp silencer, rear wind shield glass, diesel tank, rear wheel both suspensions of car bearing No.KA-03-AB-7514 are damaged, he get repaired car at Thrive Automobiles by spending more than Rs.3,00,000/- by leaving the car in the garage for five months, collected repaired car on 13.09.2022, spent Rs.50,000/- towards miscellaneous expenses,
transportation and supervision.

Petitioner stated that being the owner of car bearing Lakshman.G vs Purushotham Gowda on 6 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72581083/
3 No.KA-03-AB-7514 earning not less than Rs.4,000/- per day.
Petitioner stated that through Acko General Insurance Co. Ltd., collected Rs.1,32,000/- as damages under own damage clause in total repair charges of Rs.3,00,000/-.

15. In the evidence P.W.2-Anand Hadapad/car repair worker in Thrive Automobiles, Industrial Suburb, Tumkur road, stated that in the garage he repaired the car bearing No.KA-03-AB-7514 at the cost of Rs.3,00,000/- and delivered the repaired car on 13.09.2022.
16.

In Ex.P.5-Motor Vehicles Acident Report, Motor Vehicles Inspector noted that on 12.05.2022 during inspection, he noticed damage at right rear wheels, disc, dickie and door rear bumper, both tail lamp, assey silencer rear wind shield glass both side body, both suspensions of car bearing No.KA-03-AB-7514.
Receipt voucher-Ex.P.10 shows that on 13.9.2022 Thrive Automobiles received Rs.2,00,000/- from the petitioner.

Copy of Registration Certificate marked at Ex.P.11 shows during December, 2014, car bearing No.KA-03-AB-7514 has been manufactured and on 2.1.2015 same car has been registered in the name of petitioner.

Ex.P.13 is the comprehensive policy of car bearing No.
KA-03-AB-7514 for the period from 15.8.2022 to 13.7.2022.
17.
Above referred materials shows that after eight years from the date of manufacture, car bearing No. KA-03- AB-7514 met with an accident resulting in the damage.

18. In the copy of the policy marked at Ex.P.13 dated 14.4.2022, petitioner declared the value of the car bearing No. KA-03-AB-7514 is Rs.3,00,000/-.
19.

As referred above, in the petition itself petitioner admitted that in the expenses of Rs.3,00,000/-
spent towards repair of Toyota Etios car, the insurer of car bearing No.KA-03-AB-7514 under own damage clause paid Rs.1,32,000/-.
20.

In this case respondent No.1 and 2 remained ex- parte.
21.

Considering the date of the manufacture of the car bearing No.KA-03-AB-7514, age of car as on the date of incident, money paid by the insurer of car bearing No.KA- 03-AB-7514 under own damage clause, I have estimated the damages payable by the respondent No.1 and 2-owner and driver the car bearing No.KA-05-MJ-5250 at Rs.50,000/- with current and future interest at the rate of 6% p.a. to the petitioner.

22. Even though in this case respondent No.1 and 2- owner and driver remained absent, copy of accusation marked at Ex.P.8 shows that in C.C.No.5314/2022, respondent No.2-Rahul M. admitted the commission of offence u/s.279, 337, 338 and Section 146, r/w. Section 196 of IMV Act i.e. using of the car without insurance coverage.

As referred above, copy of judgment dated 29.1.2024 passed by this authority in MVC No.5058/2022 shows that in that case award has been passed directing the respondent-Rahul Madaiah, driver of the car bearing No.KA-05-MJ-5250 to pay compensation to the claimant - Surath Sahil Rao.

Lakshman.G vs Purushotham Gowda on 6 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72581083/
4 23.
Hence, I have inferred that an award is to be passed directing the respondents to pay damages to the petitioner.
Hence, I answer Point No.2 accordingly and pass the following :
ORDER The petition filed under Section 166 of IMV Act is hereby partly allowed.
The respondents shall pay Rs.50,000/- (Rupees fifty thousand only) with current and future interest at the rate of 6% p.a., to the petitioner towards damages.
The respondents shall deposit the damages with interest within 3 months from today.
After deposit of the damages, entire damages and interest may be released to the petitioner by crediting the same to his bank account directly .
Advocate's fee is fixed at Rs.1,000/- .
Draw an Award accordingly.

(Dictated to the Stenographer Gr.I, transcribed by her, corrected, signed and then pronounced by me in the Open Court on this the 6th day of February, 2025)
(J.N.SUBRAMANYA) Chief Judge, Court of Small Causes & Member, Prl. M.A.C.T.
Bangalore.
